findings.finding: After cross-source identity consolidation, a second accepted RSS Signal for the same project and activity unconditionally overwrites an existing still-supported Prospect's tier, required_mw, rationale, and supply. A separate current Prospect source can therefore lose its supported 42 MW requirement and constraint solely because a weaker Signal was processed later. The new tests cover Signal plus Signal and a lone Prospect, but not both orders on one shared need. This conflicts with preserving prior accepted claims and evidence-based tier state.
findings.repair: For an already shared need, derive displayed qualification fields from current accepted supporting interpretations for that exact project and activity, using the existing deterministic Prospect gate and evidence binding. A new Signal must not erase a still-current supported Prospect; when the Prospect source is corrected or withdrawn, recompute to the remaining Signal without inventing demand or supply. Add the two ingestion orders, Prospect withdrawal, source attribution, and replay stability as focused tests. Keep qualification rules unchanged.

findings.finding: labeled_site returns the first matching labeled address even when one article names two different labeled project sites. RSS matching then treats that first address plus a project name as decisive cross-source identity. An article describing alternatives such as Site address: 100 Main Street and Site address: 200 Elm Street can be merged to the existing 100 Main project despite unresolved site identity, violating the ambiguous-record boundary.
findings.repair: Extract distinct labeled sites and allow site-based matching only when exactly one is supported; multiple conflicting sites remain separate with a durable ambiguity reason. Add a two-site RSS ingestion case against an existing project.

direction: One bounded repair on shared-need qualification recomputation and ambiguous labeled-site matching, with focused integration tests. Preserve r1 evidence, no qualification-rule or adapter rewrite, then re-freeze and rerun exact-candidate gates and independent review.
